model.description: The model a session starts with: `connection/model`, a connection from connections.yaml and one of its models.

small_model.description: `connection/model` for small jobs — session titles, commit messages. Default: the session's model. On a server that holds one model at a time (llama-swap), another model here swaps.

titles.description: Session titles: model (default) — named from the first prompt, then by the model after its first reply; prompt — only from the first prompt, no extra request.

mode.description: The permission mode a session starts in (default manual).

theme.description: Colours: moria (default), shire, lembas, lembas-light, hermes, mono, or a themes/<name>.yaml of your own.

theme_background.description: theme (default): the theme paints the whole screen; terminal: the terminal's own background shows, and the theme colours only text, panels and accents.

skin.description: The old name of `theme`; still read when `theme` is not set.

busy_input.description: A message sent while the agent works: steer (default) — it goes in at the next step, after the running tools finish, and the agent carries on with it; queue — it is sent as the next prompt once the task is done.

mouse.description: false: leave the mouse to the terminal — its own selection and Ctrl+Shift+C work without Shift, and the wheel no longer scrolls the transcript (pgup/pgdn do). Default true.

icons.description: emoji (default), or plain: one-column symbols for a terminal font that has no emoji.

personality.description: How the agent talks: concise, pragmatic, optimistic, funny, formal, socratic, custom (personality_custom's text), or empty for none (the default). The same presets as the LLeMbas web UI; appended last to the system prompt, under "## Personality".

personality_custom.description: The personality, in your own words: used when personality is custom (at most 1500 characters).

enabled.description: false: no memory tool and nothing remembered in the prompt.

memory_chars.description: Size limits in characters: memory 2200, user 1375 by default.

external_dirs.description: More directories of skills, read-only; a skill of the same name elsewhere wins.

permission.description: Rules per tool: `tool: allow|ask|deny` or `tool: { pattern: action }`; the last match wins.

hardline_extra.description: Global config only: extra never-allowed bash regexes.

hardline_disable.description: Global config only: ids of built-in hardline rules to switch off.

steps.description: Most model steps in one prompt (default 200) — a runaway backstop, not a budget.

bash_timeout.description: Seconds a bash command may run in the foreground before it goes on in the background as a job (default 120).

jobs.description: Background commands one session may have running at once (default 8).

subagent_steps.description: Most model steps in one subagent run (default 50) — a runaway backstop, not a budget.

wall_seconds.description: Budget for one prompt: seconds of work, not counting time spent waiting for you. Past it the model answers from what it has. Unset: none.

output_bytes.description: Budget for one prompt: bytes of tool output read. Unset: none.

completion_tokens.description: Budget for one prompt: tokens the model writes. Unset: none.

unattended.description: With nobody to answer (headless): take the recommended option, the first, or fail.

compaction.description: Automatic context management: past auto_at of the window, old tool outputs are pruned, then the conversation is compacted. auto_at: 1 turns it off.

instructions.description: Custom instructions: how you want to be helped, in your own words (at most 4000 characters). Appended near the end of the system prompt, under "## How the person you are talking to wants to be helped" — as in the LLeMbas web UI. (A list of files here, from an older config, is read as instruction_files.)

instruction_files.description: More instruction files for the system prompt, besides AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md.

order.description: Providers to try, in order; the first that answers wins. Default: those configured (webui first), then ddg. webui: the LLeMbas instance's own search.

firecrawl.description: API (api.firecrawl.dev, with a key) or self-hosted (its own URL, no key needed).

webui.description: Search through a LLeMbas instance: its provider, its settings, its keys.

connection.description: Which webui connection (default: the only one there is).

fetch.description: How web_fetch reads a page: here, through Firecrawl's scrape, or through the LLeMbas instance.

voice.description: Voice in and out. Global only — it carries endpoints and keys, like a connection.

provider.description: openai: POST {base_url}/audio/transcriptions (OpenAI, whisper.cpp's server with its OpenAI path, faster-whisper servers). whispercpp: POST {base_url}/inference (whisper.cpp's own). webui: the LLeMbas instance's.

connection.description: webui: which webui connection (default: the only one there is).

prompt.description: Words it should expect: names, jargon.

fallback.description: Used when the provider above cannot be reached — for webui, when the instance is down. Same fields.

provider.description: openai: POST {base_url}/audio/transcriptions (OpenAI, whisper.cpp's server with its OpenAI path, faster-whisper servers). whispercpp: POST {base_url}/inference (whisper.cpp's own). webui: the LLeMbas instance's.

connection.description: webui: which webui connection (default: the only one there is).

prompt.description: Words it should expect: names, jargon.

provider.description: openai: POST {base_url}/audio/speech (OpenAI, Kokoro-FastAPI). piper-http: POST {base_url} with {text} (piper's http_server). piper-cli: the piper program. webui: the LLeMbas instance's, in the account's voice.

connection.description: webui: which webui connection (default: the only one there is).

command.description: piper-cli: the program (default piper) and the voice model file (.onnx).

fallback.description: Used when the provider above cannot be reached — for webui, when the instance is down. Same fields.

provider.description: openai: POST {base_url}/audio/speech (OpenAI, Kokoro-FastAPI). piper-http: POST {base_url} with {text} (piper's http_server). piper-cli: the piper program. webui: the LLeMbas instance's, in the account's voice.

connection.description: webui: which webui connection (default: the only one there is).

command.description: piper-cli: the program (default piper) and the voice model file (.onnx).

record_key.description: The key that starts and stops recording (default ctrl+t).

record_mode.description: toggle (default): press to start, press again (or silence) to stop. hold: also stops when the key is let go, in terminals that report it (the kitty keyboard protocol).

submit.description: What happens to what you said: draft (default) puts it in the prompt to check; send sends it.

speak.description: Speak every reply (default false; /speak toggles it).

silence_seconds.description: Seconds of silence after speech that end a recording (default 3), and the longest one (120).

silence_threshold.description: Loudness (RMS of 16-bit samples) below which it counts as silence (default 200).

recorder.description: auto, or a program: arecord, pw-record, parec, sox, ffmpeg. `recorder_command` instead: any command printing raw 16 kHz mono signed 16-bit little-endian audio to stdout.

player.description: auto, or a program: pw-play, paplay, aplay, ffplay, mpv, afplay. `player_command` instead: any command; the WAV file's path is added at the end.

mcp.description: MCP servers by name. `{env:}`/`{file:}` are filled in per server (a missing one disables that server only). A project's servers count only once the project is trusted.

command.description: A local server: the program (and its arguments, as a list). Either this or url.

env.description: Environment for the local server; {env:}/{file:} work here.

url.description: A remote server: its streamable HTTP (or SSE) address. Either this or command.

headers.description: Extra HTTP headers, e.g. Authorization: Bearer {env:TOKEN}.

transport.description: http (default: streamable HTTP, falling back to SSE) or sse.

oauth.description: OAuth for a remote server: on by default when the server asks for it; false turns it off.

enabled.description: false: configured but not started (/mcp on starts it).

tools.description: Which of its tools to offer: include wins; names or globs (`create_*`).

prompts.description: Offer its prompts as /server:prompt commands (default true).

resources.description: Offer list/read tools for its resources, if it has any (default true).

instructions.description: Put the server's own instructions into the system prompt (default true).

knowledge.description: The knowledge bases searched (lembas kb); absent: all of them. A project's own config narrows it to what that project needs.

embedding.description: Global config only. connection/model of an embedding model (OpenAI-shaped /embeddings, or Ollama): knowledge bases are then searched by meaning as well as by words. lembas kb reindex after changing it.

effort.description: The effort a session starts with, when the model takes it; otherwise the model's own default.

settings_tool.description: Global config only. The agent's settings tool: ask (default) — each change is approved like any tool call; allow — changes go through without asking (a less strict mode still asks); off — no settings tool.

update.description: Global config only. Updating LLeMbas CLI itself.

channel.description: stable (default): releases vX.Y.Z only. beta: also vX.Y.Z-beta.N — whichever is newest.

auto.description: On start: install (default) — fetch, verify and install a newer release, then say so; notify — only say one is out; off — never look.

source.description: Default: the public LLeMbas CLI releases on GitHub.

type.description: github or gitea (Forgejo too): their releases API. static: any web directory with files `stable` and `beta` naming a tag, and the assets under <tag>/.

url.description: gitea: the forge (https://git.example.org). github: the API (default https://api.github.com). static: the directory.

token.description: For a private repository: {env:NAME} or {file:~/path}, never pasted. Or key_cmd.

public_key.description: The ssh-ed25519 key(s) a release's SHA256SUMS.sig must be signed with — instead of LLeMbas CLI's own. For your own builds.

verify.description: signature (default): SHA256SUMS must carry a valid signature. checksum: checksums only — for a source of your own that does not sign.

prototypes.description: Global config only. Offer the model prototypes: a complete HTML page in a `prototype-chat` or `prototype-page` fence, saved as a file under the state directory (prototypes/<session>/) and listed by /prototype; the LLeMbas web UI renders the same fences live. Default false.

library.description: Global config only. local (default): memory, notes, skills and knowledge on this machine. lembas: the account's on the LLeMbas instance you are logged in to, through its /mcp — the same tools its chats have (needs a login with the library scope).

remote.description: Global config only. What a LLeMbas instance may ask of this machine over the link: the device decides, never the server.

enabled.description: Accept work from a LLeMbas instance this machine is logged in to (lembas service). Default false.

roots.description: The directories a remote session may be opened in, and anything under them. Empty: none.

max_mode.description: The most permissive mode a remote session may run in (default edit). auto only when set here.

approval_timeout.description: Seconds an approval waits for an answer from the web before it counts as a denial (default 600).

require_trust.description: Only projects trusted on this machine (default true).

terminal.description: Let the web UI open a terminal here (LLeMbas's terminal panel on a chat on this device): a login shell as this user, in a directory remote sessions may use. Default false.

terminal_integration.description: Shell integration in those terminals (bash, zsh, fish): after your own startup files, the shell marks each prompt, command and exit status (OSC 133) and its directory (OSC 7), so the web UI shows the directory, a mark beside each finished command, and can jump between commands. false: the shell starts as it is. Default true.

title: LLeMbas CLI config.yaml
description: ~/.config/lembas/config.yaml, or a project's .agent/config.yaml. Strings may be {env:NAME} or {file:path}.
